author: Famous0110
quote:
I can only really commend this game for its Graphics; almost every other aspect that we have come to expect from this series is seriously lacking... story writing, character development is abysmal - I could not care less about any of it.
game design, combat and driving are not refined or thoughtful... the roads are too narrow, map lay out feels shallow, combat and gunplay is boring and lacks consequences.

this is GTA for people who have never played and are unable to play real GTA... its just a skin on top of a feminized and neutered rendition of GTA. I dont think there is any fixing this, because the problems are too deep... people holding out for PC modders to give us a playable version of this game are wishful thinking... the game is poorly designed at its core.

author: Famous0110
quote:
Game is shallow, more design and care put into aesthetic skin items that are sold via a in-game store rather then functionalities and game mechanics... we have given the developer plenty of feedback about what needs to be changed, and they constantly fail to act on jf.

Maybe I'll return to the game in a year or two and things will be different but in its current state the game is just bad.
